name: trafficity-mod-manager
description: Lightweight mod manager, extensible game facade, ASAR patcher, and Qt6 Quick desktop UI for Trafficity

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && node --test test/*.test.mjs examples/*/*.test.mjs
scripts.build:ui: mkdir -p ui/build bin && cd ui/build && qmake6 ../trafficity-mod-manager.pro && make -j$(nproc) && cp -f --remove-destination trafficity-mod-manager ../../bin/trafficity-mod-manager
